name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, fueled by late nights tinkering with go-karts and a deep fascination with vehicle dynamics. He holds a Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering and began his career in a local engineering firm before transitioning to a smaller Malaysian racing team. There, he quickly established himself as a meticulous and insightful performance engineer. 

His approach centers around data-driven decision-making, combined with an intuitive understanding of driver feedback. Ahmad believes in fostering strong communication within the team, ensuring everyone is aligned and working towards shared goals. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and efficiently, often making crucial setup adjustments during race weekends that lead to significant performance gains.

What sets Ahmad apart is his unwavering commitment to his team and his dedication to continuous improvement. He's always exploring new technologies and methodologies to optimize vehicle performance, making him a valuable asset to any racing organization.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race weekend with a cup of strong teh tarik from his favorite vendor.
